blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. The help desk team is small, but they are very responsive.

In this lesson you learn the everyday English you need when you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting. Sophie calls IT support whenever something looks strange.

Good IT habits protect the whole company. Small habits today save big problems tomorrow. You can do it — one step at a time.

items.q: Which offices does IT support?
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: How is the help desk team described?
items.why: "The help desk team is small, but they are very responsive."

items.q: When does Sophie call IT support?
items.why: "Sophie calls IT support whenever something looks strange."

items.q: The text suggests that good IT habits…
items.why: Inferência: "Small habits today save big problems tomorrow" — pequenos hábitos evitam problemas grandes depois.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: a small team can still help everyone
a big problem always needs a big team
items.why: Inferência: o time é pequeno, mas responsivo e apoia todos os escritórios.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James apresentando a equipe de help desk. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello, and welcome to the IT help desk team. We are small, but we help every office, from London to São Paulo.

This is Anna. She is a technician. She fixes computers, and she is very fast. If your laptop is slow, Anna can help you. Just send her a message.

Next to Anna is Marco. He is an analyst. He looks at problems and he finds answers. He is quiet, but he is very smart. When the data looks strange, Marco checks it.

This is Lucia. She is the manager. She leads the team, and she plans the work. When you have a big problem, Lucia is ready to help you.

And this is Tom. He is my colleague. He works the night shift, so he is not here in the morning. He answers your calls in the evening. He is calm and very kind.

So, that is the team. They are small, but they are very responsive. If something looks strange, call us. We are always ready for your next IT task. Remember: good IT habits protect the whole company.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Anna's job?
options: She is a colleague from London
items.why: "This is Anna. She is a technician. She fixes computers."

items.q: Who is the manager of the team?
items.why: "This is Lucia. She is the manager. She leads the team."

items.q: When does Tom answer your calls?
items.why: "He works the night shift… He answers your calls in the evening."

items.q: Why is Tom NOT there in the morning?
options: Because he works the night shift
items.why: Inferência: ele trabalha no turno da noite, por isso não está de manhã.

items.q: What does James want you to feel about the team?
options: That it is small but ready to help
That it only works in São Paulo
That it is too big to help
items.why: Inferência: "They are small, but they are very responsive… We are always ready."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The technician is fixing my laptop right now." A technician is…
options: a person who fixes technical things
items.why: Technician = técnico: a pessoa que conserta equipamentos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There is a new ___ who looks at the data and finds answers."
items.why: Analyst = analista: quem analisa os dados e encontra respostas.

items.q: "She leads the team and plans the work." She is the manager. A manager is…
options: a person who leads a team
a person who cleans the office
items.why: Manager = gerente: quem lidera a equipe.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "My ___ sits next to me, and we work together every day."
items.why: Colleague = colega: a pessoa com quem você trabalha.

items.q: "Tom works the night shift." A shift is…
options: a set period of work time
items.why: Shift = turno: o período de trabalho (dia ou noite).

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que a equipe de IT usa no dia a dia. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please log in with your name and password." To log in means to…
options: enter a system with your details
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com seu usuário e senha.

items.q: "Always back up your files." To back up means to…
options: save a copy of your files
items.why: Back up = fazer cópia de segurança dos arquivos.

items.q: "If it is slow, restart your computer." To restart means to…
options: turn it off and on again
items.why: Restart = reiniciar: desligar e ligar de novo.

items.q: "I will follow up with you tomorrow." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar retorno / checar de novo depois.

items.q: "The technician will set up your new laptop." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = configurar / deixar pronto para usar.
